channel.title: Garden Rescue
channel.desc: Chris Hull and Charlie Dimmock are in Swindon to transform Andy and Mandi's garden, which is full of awkward level changes, into an Italian courtyard with clever links to the rest of the plot and a place where they can relax and enjoy time spent with family and friends. Can the team achieve all this on a ?6,000 budget?
